title: Dashboard catalog (v1.0)
description: Metric components for the multi_catalog sample.
instructions: These components show numbers on a surface whose default catalog is another one, such as the basic catalog. Each component from this catalog MUST set `catalogId` to this catalog's id. Lay them out with the layout components of the surface's default catalog, for example a Row of StatCards.

StatCard.description: Shows one headline number with a label, and optionally a short caption such as the change from the previous period.

label.description: What the number measures, for example 'Revenue'.

caption.description: Optional context, for example '+12% vs Q2'.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column, like the CSS 'flex-grow' property.

ProgressBar.description: Shows progress toward a goal as a horizontal bar.

label.description: What the bar tracks, for example 'Quarterly target'.

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column, like the CSS 'flex-grow' property.
